messages:
mara: Quick decision for the Lighthouse mini (3 days): do we take the embed reliability hotfix that affects paying tenants, or the onboarding modal polish that boosts new-user activation? Need a decision so I can update the board.

omar: Reliability-first. Support has 4 tickets and an SRE alert this morning.

lex: +1. Repro steps in staging take ~20m; looks like a malformed payload path. Can spike a minimal guard today.

nidhi: Data note: modal polish improves activation for new users by ~2.3% but it's not customer-facing revenue. Embed failures hit enterprise flows. Prioritize reliability.

sam: If we go reliability, scope the work to a single PR: defensive parsing + retries + tests + canary. Avoid a refactor. I can own the rollout.

mara: Agreed. Plan: 1) reproduce + failing test (same day) 2) implement guard + retries 3) integration test 4) canary to 5% for 6h and monitor SLI. Owners: Lex -> fix + tests, Sam -> canary + rollout, Nidhi -> dashboard watch.

lex: I'll open branch hotfix/embed-guard and add a WIP PR. Local repro command:

```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embed -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV' -d '{"input":"\u0000weird\u0000payload"}'
```

nidhi: I'll create a temporary dashboard card for the canary cohort and add alerts on embed_error_rate and p99 latency.

sam: I'll draft a short customer-facing update to affected tenants once canary is green.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for commit 7b2e9f to cluster lighthouse-1.

mara: Action recap: Lex -> PR + tests; Sam -> canary rollout + customer note; Nidhi -> SLI/watch; Mara -> move modal polish ticket to "wave-b" with acceptance criteria. Target: verify canary within 24h. Any objections?

omar: No objections.

lex: Opening WIP PR and assigning reviewers @sam @mara. Will ping when canary starts.

mara: Thanks team. We'll pick up the modal polish in the next wave and add the metric slice so it's ready to be picked up without re-scoping. :thumbsup:
